A harness for agents and automatic workflows

Mission Control belongs to Sourcery. It coordinates agent work through the internal job system: tasks, workers, progress, results and review. Claimipedia Science is one application of that mechanism.

How Mission Control works
  1. Define the work

    Frame a task, its scope and the authority it needs.

  2. Coordinate jobs and agents

    Manage worker lanes and bounded work through the internal job system.

  3. Bring results back

    Keep progress and evidence visible, with findings returned for review.
